# Incomplete Data Persistence on Compilation Failure

In the case of an error during the compilation process, the code may not fully rollback or recover the state, leading to inconsistent data in the database.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._compile_one`
